name: parity-overlay-testbed
description: Locally-hosted @bsv/overlay-express stack for hermetic SHIP/SLAP admission parity tests. Not published, not a public interface.
_pinning: Using @bsv/overlay-express@0.7.5 (the latest canonical on npm as of 2026-04-21) which bundles compatible @bsv/overlay, @bsv/overlay-discovery-services, and @bsv/sdk 1.x. npm resolves the full tree. The exact SDK version matters for the bsv-rs Layer-1 goldens — keep this in rough sync with tests/parity/ts-fixtures/package.json (which pins @bsv/sdk 1.10.1). If the admission policy ever diverges, check .package-lock.json here vs there.
